risks: model ranking does not hold across windows
only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~161% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.068), which favours a robust combination.

Test a weighted combination using inverse_error weighting over the full model pool to see if a data‑driven weight improves on the best single THETA baseline.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single THETA' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score -0.0622. Series context: trend strength 0.9824 and seasonal strength 0.3964; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.068); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.153.
